changes: Used side-by-side layout with 3-row columns text arrangement so the formula and all three active explanation lines fit without truncation.
Mapped main stage with 44 px per meter and pivot at (164, 68) so the full -2.9 to 2.9 m swing and 18 px bob fit inside the 304 by 260.8 px box.
Placed pivot_label above pivot_dot to keep it clear of the swinging strings and bobs.
Dropped plumb_label because placing it on plumb_line collides with the pendulum strings and bobs passing through zero.
Hid the panel plot title so the coordinate-plot fits the 260.8 px height with its legend and keeps the Reset button clear.
Shortened value labels Max speed to Speed and Frequency to Freq to fit the 200 px values column, and dropped Energy as only three values fit.
